name: Standalone startup / intended power
prerequisites: Already programmed assembled target, verified approved supply, output initially at safe low setting; ST-Link and serial cable disconnected.
procedure: Connect intended battery or approved AC supply.
Power the device normally with programming and serial connections physically unplugged.
Observe startup, output mute/ramp, and successful response to an available user control.
expected: Device starts without a laptop or reflashing.
No alarming output transient; source and control become usable.
gate: Battery/power solution must be electrically validated.

name: Bluetooth audio input and real playback
prerequisites: Paired compatible phone and approved audio signal; other inputs off; safe measured listening level.
procedure: Select Bluetooth through the physical user interface.
Play a known speech/music excerpt on the phone, then pause and resume.
Repeat after increasing the source separation within the stated operating range.
expected: Audio follows phone play/pause at the actual transducer without a serial monitor.
Volume changes are controlled and repeatable.
gate: Check actual BT radio transport; original BLE audio claim is unverified.

name: Induction-loop / telecoil reception
prerequisites: Real powered hearing loop or calibrated magnetic induction fixture; Bluetooth audio silent.
procedure: Bring the telecoil into a repeatable induction field.
Select telecoil and play identifiable audio via induction.
Move telecoil away and return to show changing coupling.
expected: Inductively received audio is audible; it is not merely direct electrical injection.
gate: Requires a confirmed magnetic field source and assembled front end.

name: Ambient microphone and independent dual inputs
prerequisites: Verified one/two microphone channels, consistent gain and access to both acoustic angles.
procedure: Switch to ambient mode and speak at a repeatable distance.
For dual-mic claim, speak to the left and right of the array.
Demonstrate a repeatable externally audible difference with the directional control.
expected: Both claimed microphone channels independently affect directional response.
gate: NOT AVAILABLE on current integrated G5; must port and verify before declaring PASS.

name: Real source precedence, loss and recovery
prerequisites: Two real input sources prepared with distinguishable tones/phrases; initial mode AUTO.
procedure: Present source A alone, then introduce source B without firmware restart.
Confirm the documented priority by identifying which sound is heard.
Disconnect the winning source; time observable mute, fallback and recovery.
Reconnect source and repeat in a different order.
expected: Physical audio, not a GUI flag, follows the documented precedence.
No reset required; measured recovery time recorded against signed-off threshold.
gate: Only BT/telecoil transitions can be claimed before microphone port.

name: Physical controls and unexpected sequences
prerequisites: Accessible labeled fitted controls and safe audible stimulus; wear sensor if claimed.
procedure: Use a physical control to change volume or sound profile twice.
Toggle manual/automatic source policy in a different order from the rehearsal.
If fitted, remove and replace wearable unit to demonstrate wear status.
expected: Each action has observable audible/visual effect without UART or laptop.
No duplicate clicks or missed operation; wearer detection works if claimed.
gate: Nucleo B1 is valid only for the Nucleo target, not custom PCB.

name: Dynamic gain, filter/noise response and feedback
prerequisites: Calibrated external source, repeatable quiet/noisy recording, fixed transducer coupling; safe output.
procedure: Play two prescribed sound input levels; compare audible or instrumented output.
Compare identical noise/speech segment with processing off/on.
Apply controlled low-level feedback challenge if suppression is implemented.
expected: Automatic gain responds with measured different gain.
Any claimed noise/feedback improvement has externally measured evidence.
gate: Current C filters are verified numerically; end-to-end SNR/feedback suppression NOT verified.

name: Acoustic latency, distortion and output level
prerequisites: Preconfigured calibrated acoustic fixture and recorder; nominal signal levels; staff-approved safe tests.
procedure: Play the defined impulse/tone stimulus and capture external source/output traces.
Measure impulse response latency, THD at nominal level, and safe acoustic output.
Compare to documented <50 ms, <3% and signed-off output-level thresholds.
expected: Actual instrument readings within each defined threshold; method and uncertainty recorded.
gate: Unavailable without proper calibrated transducer fixture; PCM limiter is not proof of SPL.

name: Mechanical enclosure and controls
prerequisites: Assembled enclosure/headband, no unsafe exposed edges, callipers.
procedure: Measure the earpiece envelope and inspect retained PCB, lid, strain relief, controls and connectors.
Demonstrate don/doff and head movement without cable snagging.
expected: <=60 mm earpiece target; secure assembly and unobstructed sound inlet/output.
gate: Current KiCad files do not prove assembled mechanical functionality.

name: Robustness with unanticipated user action
prerequisites: Normal playback; safe level; lecturer chooses alternate gesture sequence.
procedure: Invite examiner to perform available legal button/encoder actions in any order.
Observe playback continuity and successful response, without reboot.
expected: Actions remain responsive and device continues behaving safely.
gate: Pass only after unpredictable on-hardware repetition.

name: Wear state and power-consumption change
prerequisites: Approved meter connected to supply external to the audio path; wear sensor calibrated.
procedure: Record current in actively worn/operating state.
Remove device and wait agreed inactivity interval; record supply current again.
Reapply wear stimulus; confirm correct return to operation.
expected: Current difference meets signed-off limit with no boot-loop.
gate: G5 M3 source-idle state is not MCU STOP mode; cannot claim this result yet.

name: Prior qualification evidence: endurance, environment and safety
prerequisites: Dated original external records of full 24-h battery discharge, chamber and physical endurance testing; compliance evidence if claimed.
procedure: Show only original instrument logs and hardware IDs for each long-duration test.
Confirm the demonstrated device revision matches recorded firmware and BOM.
Identify and openly declare missing studies or non-applicable compliance assertions.
expected: Claims are supported by authentic prior observations, not estimated runtime or simulation.
gate: This presentation does not substitute for actually carrying out long qualification trials.

name: End-of-test fault challenge and self-protection
prerequisites: Sound at safe level, one physically detachable non-damaging source; any potentially destructive safety challenge approved and LAST.
procedure: Disconnect an externally accessible input, or let examiner choose another safe fault.
Observe bounded output response, no spurious loud sound, and recovery when restored.
Do not apply a destructive test without appropriate protection and lecturer approval.
expected: System fails safely, does not require flash/reset and resumes if recovery is supported.
gate: No claim of protected overcurrent/short-circuit behavior without real protective hardware.
